name: PdxMaskedInput
description:
An input that formats what the user types to a pattern, a built-in preset such as phone, card or
date, or a custom one.

members.name: mask
members.description:
Mask pattern: # = digit, A = letter, * = any. Or a preset: phone, phone-intl (a 1-3 digit
country code, read from its prefix), card, date (MM/DD/YYYY), time (HH:MM), ssn, zip,
zip-ext. A complete date or time out of range sets aria-invalid.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name, submitted with the form.

members.name: size
members.description: xs, sm, md (the default), lg or xl — the same scale as pdx-input.

members.name: value
members.description: The value. A form submits it, and an empty entry when it is empty, as a text input does (#135).

members.name: selectText
members.description: Select the whole text, so the next keystroke replaces it. Does not focus first.

members.name: getFormatted
members.description: The value as shown, with the mask's literals: `(555) 123-4567` for `5551234567`.

members.name: isValid
members.description: False while a complete date or time preset value is out of range.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.
